verses.zh: （ 耶 和 華 的 僕 人 大 衛 的 詩 ， 交 與 伶 長 。 ） 惡 人 的 罪 過 在 他 心 裡 說 ： 我 眼 中 不 怕 神 ！
verses.en: For the music director, an oracle, written by the Lord’s servant David.[NOTE:1] An evil man is rebellious to the core.[NOTE:2] He does not fear God,[NOTE:3]
notes: Psalm 36. Though evil men plan to harm others, the psalmist is confident that the Lord is the just ruler of the earth who gives and sustains all life. He prays for divine blessing and protection and anticipates God’s judgment of the wicked.

In the Hebrew text the word נאם (“oracle”) appears at the beginning of the next verse (v. 2 in the Hebrew text because the superscription is considered v. 1). The resulting reading, “an oracle of rebellion for the wicked [is] in the midst of my heart” (cf. NIV) apparently means that the psalm, which foresees the downfall of the wicked, is a prophetic oracle about the rebellion of the wicked which emerges from the soul of the psalmist. One could translate, “Here is a poem written as I reflected on the rebellious character of evil men.” Another option, followed in the translation above, is to attach נאם (ne’um, “oracle”) with the superscription. For another example of a Davidic poem being labeled an “oracle,” see 2 Sam 23:1.

Heb “[the] rebellion of an evil man [is] in the midst of my heart.” The translation assumes a reading “in the midst of his heart” (i.e., “to the core”) instead of “in the midst of my heart,” a change which finds support in a few medieval Hebrew mss, the Hebrew text of Origen’s Hexapla, and the Syriac.

verses.zh: 他 自 誇 自 媚 ， 以 為 他 的 罪 孽 終 不 顯 露 ， 不 被 恨 惡 。
verses.en: for he is too proudto recognize and give up his sin.[NOTE:1]
notes: Psalm 36. Though evil men plan to harm others, the psalmist is confident that the Lord is the just ruler of the earth who gives and sustains all life. He prays for divine blessing and protection and anticipates God’s judgment of the wicked.

verses.zh: 他 口 中 的 言 語 盡 是 罪 孽 詭 詐 ； 他 與 智 慧 善 行 已 經 斷 絕 。
verses.en: The words he speaks are sinful and deceitful;he does not care about doing what is wise and right.[NOTE:1]
notes: Psalm 36. Though evil men plan to harm others, the psalmist is confident that the Lord is the just ruler of the earth who gives and sustains all life. He prays for divine blessing and protection and anticipates God’s judgment of the wicked.

verses.en: While he lies in bed he plans ways to sin.He is committed to a sinful lifestyle;[NOTE:1] he does not reject what is evil.[NOTE:2]

verses.en: How precious[NOTE:1] is your loyal love, O God!The human race finds shelter under your wings.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 他 們 必 因 你 殿 裡 的 肥 甘 得 以 飽 足 ； 你 也 必 叫 他 們 喝 你 樂 河 的 水 。
verses.en: They are filled with food from your house,and you allow them to drink from the river of your delicacies.

verses.zh: 因 為 ， 在 你 那 裡 有 生 命 的 源 頭 ； 在 你 的 光 中 ， 我 們 必 得 見 光 。
verses.en: For with you is the fountain of life;in your light we see light.[NOTE:1]
notes: Psalm 36. Though evil men plan to harm others, the psalmist is confident that the Lord is the just ruler of the earth who gives and sustains all life. He prays for divine blessing and protection and anticipates God’s judgment of the wicked.

verses.zh: 願 你 常 施 慈 愛 給 認 識 你 的 人 ， 常 以 公 義 待 心 裡 正 直 的 人 。
verses.en: Extend[NOTE:1] your loyal love to your faithful followers,[NOTE:2] and vindicate[NOTE:3] the morally upright.[NOTE:4]

Heb “there is no dread of God before his eyes.” The phrase “dread of God” refers here to a healthy respect for God which recognizes that he will punish evil behavior.

verses.zh: 不 容 驕 傲 人 的 腳 踐 踏 我 ； 不 容 凶 惡 人 的 手 趕 逐 我 。
verses.en: Do not let arrogant men overtake me,or let evil men make me homeless.[NOTE:1]
notes: Psalm 36. Though evil men plan to harm others, the psalmist is confident that the Lord is the just ruler of the earth who gives and sustains all life. He prays for divine blessing and protection and anticipates God’s judgment of the wicked.

verses.zh: 在 那 裡 ， 作 孽 的 人 已 經 仆 倒 ； 他 們 被 推 倒 ， 不 能 再 起 來 。
verses.en: I can see the evildoers! They have fallen.[NOTE:1] They have been knocked down and are unable to get up.[NOTE:2]
